summary: Vercel AI Gateway's free tier includes $5 per month in credits for a subset of the model catalog, with lower per-model rate limits than the paid tier. Free credits start with your first AI Gateway request. This is a monthly inclusion, not a one-time trial. Buying AI Gateway Credits moves your team to the paid tier, after which the monthly free credit no longer applies.
claim_steps: Create or sign in to a Vercel team account and open AI Gateway.
Get an AI Gateway API key and make your first request to start the $5/month free credit; choose a Free Tier eligible model and observe its rate limits.
Do not purchase AI Gateway Credits if you want to retain the monthly free credit; purchasing switches your team to the paid tier and the monthly free credit no longer applies.

social_proof.title: AI Gateway Pricing — Vercel Docs
social_proof.text: Monthly credit $5 /month included. The free tier includes a subset of models, not the full catalog. Your free credits start when you make your first AI Gateway request. Once you purchase credits, your account transitions to the paid tier and the monthly free credit no longer applies.
